warnings: All bars are printed with Ø → type RB (section 0.6 / 6). No concrete strength, steel grade or cover is printed anywhere in the set.

F1: plan 1.00 x 1.00 (pile chain 0.15+0.20+0.30+0.20+0.15 and 0.15+0.35+0.35+0.15), six piles (4 corners + 2 at mid-depth). Thickness printed '0.20' at the edge with '0.05' above it (sloped top rising to the pedestal): height_mm = 250 at the pedestal face, 200 at the edge, both kept in printed_as (same convention as house 129's spread footing). The mat is printed by spacing only ('Ø 9 มม. @0.10 #', two-way) — main_bar carries spacing_mm and no count.

Pile callout is handwritten: 'เข็มคอนกรีต Ø 0.15 x 5.00 ม. จำนวน 6 ต้น'. The length digit is the same glyph as the 5 in '0.15' (and as in the ข้อกำหนดเข็ม note on the same sheet), read as 5.00; flagged. The count 6 matches the six piles drawn in plan.
Each column has two sections by height: 'จากฐานราก → คานคอดิน' (0.30 x 0.30) and 'จากคานคอดิน → หลังคา' (0.25 x 0.25) — one entry per level (section 8).
R2 is 0.10 wide: '2-Ø 12 มม' drawn as one bar at the top and one at the bottom joined by a single hooked link 'ลูกโซ่ Ø 6 มม @0.15 ม' — recorded as top 1 / bottom 1 with the printed total kept.

ขยายครีบ ค.ส.ล. (the sloped RC eave cantilever at the gable ends, continuing the beam labelled R) and ขยายพื้น ค.ส.ล. carry no element mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). The fin's bar callouts print no spacing — bar_layers keep only what is printed.
